entities.name: Bartel Runeaxe
entities.description: A legendary Giant warrior from Dominaria who wielded a giant axe.

entities.name: Hammerheim
entities.description: Mountain stronghold on Dominaria that Bartel Runeaxe appears to be from.

events.summary: Bartel Runeaxe, a legendary Giant warrior, is described as wielding a giant axe and being unstoppable in his charge.
events.quote: He wielded a giant axe and it was said that no foe could slow his charge.

relations.note: He appears to be from the mountain stronghold.
relations.quote: He appears to be from the mountain stronghold of Hammerheim
